items.criterion: A refund at or below the caller's ceiling writes one refund row and moves available by exactly the refund amount.
items.judgment: Read available before and after the refund; the difference equals the refund amount, and one row exists for the payment.

items.criterion: A refund above the caller's ceiling is refused with the pinned code and writes no refund row.
items.judgment: The response carries the approval_required code and the refund table is unchanged.

items.criterion: A request that is waiting moves no balance and owns no ledger entry.
items.judgment: Every balance reads the same immediately after the request as immediately before, and the entry count is unchanged.

items.criterion: One approval by a different person produces exactly one refund and one balance movement.
items.judgment: The request reads executed, one refund row appears, and available falls by the requested amount once.

items.criterion: Two approvals arriving at one instant produce exactly one refund.
items.judgment: After two simultaneous approvals the refund count rises by one and available falls once.

items.criterion: A support session is denied the approve endpoint and the request row is untouched.
items.judgment: The call is denied at the API and the request still reads pending.

items.criterion: The person who raised a request is refused when approving it.
items.judgment: The call carries the self_approval_forbidden code and the request still reads pending.

items.criterion: A member of one organisation reaches nothing belonging to another.
items.judgment: A read of the other organisation's payment is answered as denied or as not found.

items.criterion: Every balance set of an organisation in one environment sums to zero across its six kinds.
items.judgment: The six amounts add to exactly zero for each seeded pair of organisation and environment.

items.criterion: Each audit record carries the hash of the record before it, numbered with no gap.
items.judgment: The sequence runs from one upward and every previous hash equals the earlier record's hash.

items.criterion: A replayed idempotency key moves the balance once and a changed body under one key is refused.
items.judgment: The second identical call creates no row, and the call with a different amount carries the idempotency_conflict code.

items.criterion: A request older than the injected lifetime reads expired and can no longer execute.
items.judgment: The request reaches the expired state on read, and a later approval carries the approval_expired code without writing a refund.

items.criterion: The sitemap names every public route and the robots file points at the sitemap.
items.judgment: Every public route appears in the sitemap body and the robots file carries a Sitemap line naming it.

items.criterion: A lead submission filling the decoy field writes no row.
items.judgment: The call is refused and the lead table count is unchanged.

items.criterion: Cards on the storefront stay visibly separate from the band beneath them by ground and elevation rather than by a border.
items.judgment: A reader looking at a card over a section band can tell the two apart with no dividing rule drawn between them.

items.criterion: Selecting a payment fills a detail pane beside the list rather than replacing the page.
items.judgment: A reader selecting a row sees the list stay in place while the pane fills.
